title: syncyomi_guard: refuse to let a collapsed sync payload overwrite the only good copy
objective: TachiyomiSY 1.13.2 can report a backup restore as SUCCESS while having written almost nothing, then push that near-empty library to the SyncYomi server and replace the last good copy (observed 2026-08-09: a 14 MB payload holding 2182 manga became a 267 KB stub). The upstream bug lives in the APK and cannot be fixed here, so this package targets the fixable half: detect a payload collapse and refuse to accept it as normal.
acceptance_criteria: Decodes the SyncYomi payload and reports counts of manga, categories and sources
Flags a collapse when a payload loses more than a tenth of its entries, not merely when it hits zero
Treats categories under their own rule, since the 2026-08-09 incident kept all 2182 manga but lost all 18 categories
Distinguishes normal drift from collapse so routine syncs are not blocked
100% branch coverage across every module in python_pkg/syncyomi_guard
Runbook documents the manual recovery path used on 2026-08-09 (WAL-page salvage)
out_of_scope: Fixing the upstream TachiyomiSY restore bug (jobobby04/TachiyomiSY#1634, #1638) — that is Kotlin in an APK
Automatically restoring a collapsed library; the guard refuses the overwrite, a human does the recovery
Changing SyncYomi server deployment or the existing setup_syncyomi.sh
verifier: python -m pytest python_pkg/syncyomi_guard --cov=python_pkg.syncyomi_guard (60 passed, 100% branch coverage on __init__, __main__, payload, store, verdict)
